correctness.rationale: Every covariance entry is determined by one of three exact occupancy types; summing them yields an explicit Frobenius operator with 1+2(n−1)+(n−1)^2=n^2 eigenvectors. Strict ordering follows from a product Bernoulli representation induced by positive Laguerre zeros and strict Bernoulli-variance concavity. Complex-uniform Perron Laguerre asymptotics and Cauchy derivative bounds give deficiency mean and variance with exact leading constants. Finite exact rational checks n=2..4 corroborate.

Primary combinatorial/geometry sources classify partial permutation polytopes or their lattice invariants; the closest published John ellipsoid uses the same symmetry splitting but a different measure/invariant with different spectral scaling.
